description: This file declares the interface for the Wi-Fi Station/Client Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL) in a network management project, including enumerations for events, method declarations for connection management, scanning, and device configuration, as well as a factory function for creating HAL instances.

classes.name: sta_wlan_hal
classes.description: Abstract class representing the WLAN Station/Client hardware abstraction layer, providing methods for connection, scanning, and configuration operations.

methods.name: ~sta_wlan_hal
methods.description: Virtual destructor for the sta_wlan_hal class.

methods.name: start_wps_pbc
methods.description: Starts the WPS Push Button Configuration process.

methods.name: initiate_scan
methods.description: Initiates a scan for available networks.

methods.name: scan_bss
methods.description: Performs a scan for a specific BSS identified by BSSID and channel.

methods.name: get_scan_results
methods.description: Retrieves scan results filtered by SSID.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to a network with specified SSID, passphrase, security type, and other parameters.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the current network.

methods.name: roam
methods.description: Performs a roaming operation to a specified BSSID and channel.

methods.name: get_4addr_mode
methods.description: Retrieves whether 4-address mode is enabled.

methods.name: set_4addr_mode
methods.description: Enables or disables 4-address mode.

methods.name: set_3addr_mcast
methods.description: Enables or disables 3-address multicast.

methods.name: unassoc_rssi_measurement
methods.description: Performs an unassociated RSSI measurement for a specified MAC and channel.

methods.name: is_connected
methods.description: Checks if the station is currently connected.

methods.name: get_channel
methods.description: Retrieves the current operating channel.

methods.name: update_status
methods.description: Updates the internal status of the HAL.

methods.name: get_ssid
methods.description: Gets the connected network's SSID.

methods.name: get_bssid
methods.description: Gets the BSSID of the current network.

methods.name: clear_non_associated_devices
methods.description: Clears records of non-associated devices.

methods.name: update_mld_mode
methods.description: Updates the MLD mode.

methods.name: update_mld_unit
methods.description: Updates the MLD unit.

methods.name: get_wireless_backhaul_mac
methods.description: Retrieves the backhaul MAC address.

methods.name: enable_disable_ep
methods.description: Enables or disables the Ethernet port or backhaul interface.
